_meta.description: Film product database recovered from Kodak/Pakon F-X35 scanner software, cross-referenced with public DX code tables.
_meta.id_scheme: Pakon 'film product' = DX number Part 1 (I3A/PIMA combination code, 0-127); 'film specifier' = DX number Part 2 (generation code, 0-15). Composite 4-digit DX number = part1*16 + part2.

pakon_sources.defaults.ini: fx35install/program files/Pakon/F-X35 COM SERVER/Config/ColorCorrection/defaults.ini (per-product user color-slider defaults; all sections empty = zero adjustment; groups product IDs by manufacturer)
pakon_sources.common-ProdCodeTable.dpi: fx35install/.../anselinstalldir/dataPathItems/common/common-ProdCodeTable.dpi ((part1 0-127) x (part2 0-15) -> film ISO speed; 'Part1/Part2 PIMA code' per its header)
pakon_sources.pnr/profiles/*.pf: film-family fpim_to_rpd color profiles: a200 c200 f200 f400 f800 ferr200 k200 k400 k800 kvr200
pakon_sources.filmLut: filmLut-scanner-prod-gen-*.lut hook; only identity default shipped

_meta.community_source: https://github.com/ffindr/dxcode-film-db (LGPL-3.0); product names are community-compiled from the I3A 'DX Codes for 135-Size Film' list and film-edge decodes, NOT from the Pakon install
_meta.verification: Pakon ISO table matches community names gen-for-gen on rows 26 (Centuria), 35 (Superia), 78 (Gold), 79 (VR/Portra), 110 (XP1/XP2 all ISO 400); Flickr crowd-sourced cartridge decodes agree (FP4+=109-12, HP5+=109-9, Delta 400=109-8, Delta 3200=108-10, XP2 Super=110-4, Tri-X=64-5).

pakon_pseudo_products.BnW: Black and White (C41 and regular) - defaults.ini section
pakon_pseudo_products.POSITIVE: Color reversal film and kodachrome - defaults.ini section
pakon_pseudo_products.IMPORTED: Imported images such as from file - defaults.ini section
